newsitem.title: JAPAN: March Nikkei futures, options settled at 17,408.46.
newsitem.headline: March Nikkei futures, options settled at 17,408.46.

text.p: March Nikkei 225 futures and options were settled at 17,408.46, the Osaka Securities Exchange said in post-market hours on Friday.
Earlier, brokers said that sell positions due to the settlement outnumbered buy positions by about 464,000 for each issue included in the Nikkei 225.
The Nikkei average ended up 23.16 points, or 0.13 percent, at 17,923.64. Its June futures added 30 to end at 17,830.
